profile.name: INFO ABDOU
profile.title: Full-stack DEV & AI Engineer
profile.tagline: I design, build and ship production systems — from the first schema to the last deploy.

availability.label: Weekend days, Sunday to Thursday at 19:45

profile.about:
I'm a freelance software engineer who works where product meets infrastructure. Most of my projects start as a vague "we need this to be faster, cheaper, or finally reliable" and end as a small, well-tested system that a team can own without me.

I write TypeScript and Go, live in Linux, and care about boring things that make software last: clear data models, observability, and deploys nobody has to be afraid of.

services.title: Product engineering
services.description: From a Figma file or a napkin sketch to a shipped, monitored product. I take ownership of the slice end to end: UI, API, database, deploy.
deliverables: Discovery workshop and a scoped delivery plan
Weekly increments you can click on
Handover docs, tests and a recorded walkthrough

services.title: Platform & DevOps
services.description: Pipelines that are fast, infrastructure that is boring, and alerts that only fire when a human is actually needed.
deliverables: GitHub Actions CI/CD with preview environments
Terraform or OpenTofu modules for your stack

services.title: Performance & reliability audit
services.description: A focused two-week engagement: measure, find the three things that actually matter, fix them, and leave a regression guard behind.
deliverables: Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals report
Prioritised fix list with effort estimates
Load test script and SLO baseline

services.title: Rescue & modernization
services.description: Inherited a codebase nobody wants to deploy? I stabilise it first, then modernise in small, reversible steps — never a big-bang rewrite.

experience.summary: Product engineering, platform work and audits for teams between seed stage and series B. Usually one engagement at a time, three to six months long.
highlights: Shipped 11 client projects; 9 are still running without me
Cut a client's cloud bill by 38% by consolidating workers and cutting idle replicas
Introduced preview environments that reduced QA hand-off time from days to hours

experience.summary: Owned the deployment platform for 40 engineers: Kubernetes, Argo CD, Terraform, and the observability stack behind it.
highlights: Migrated 60 services from VMs to EKS with zero customer-visible downtime
Built a canary analysis operator still in use today
Reduced mean deploy time from 24 minutes to 4

experience.summary: Second engineer on a B2B analytics product. Wrote the ingestion pipeline, the reporting API and most of the frontend.
highlights: Introduced end-to-end tests and a real CI pipeline

testimonials.quote: He replaced a six-month roadmap item with a three-week build that we still run in production. The handover was better than most internal projects.
